+"""Generate the fixed-instance RoboWits gap_retrieve trajectory."""
+
+import math
+import sys
+
+from rcb_robowits import Session
+
+
+output = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+s = Session("gap_retrieve", instance="/app/instance.json")
+p = s.primitives()
+q = p["top_down_quat"](math.pi / 2)
+
+s.record_start()
+
+# Lift the positive-y boundary block out of the channel.
+p["move_ee"]("left", [.55, .05, 1.06], q, linear=3)
+p["move_ee"]("left", [.55, .05, .91], q, linear=4, max_dq=.06)
+p["close_gripper"]("left", steps=30)
+p["move_ee"]("left", [.55, .05, 1.11], q, linear=4, max_dq=.06)
+p["move_ee"]("left", [.56, .45, 1.12], q, linear=5, max_dq=.06)
+p["open_gripper"]("left", steps=15)
+
+# Lift the negative-y boundary block away with the right gripper.
+p["move_ee"]("right", [.50, -.055, 1.06], q, linear=4, max_dq=.06)
+p["move_ee"]("right", [.50, -.055, .91], q, linear=4, max_dq=.06)
+p["close_gripper"]("right", steps=30)
+p["move_ee"]("right", [.50, -.055, 1.11], q, linear=4, max_dq=.06)
+p["move_ee"]("right", [.48, -.42, 1.12], q, linear=5, max_dq=.06)
+p["open_gripper"]("right", steps=15)
+
+# Pick up the lemon and bring it over the target.
+p["move_ee"]("left", [.565, .059, .93], q, linear=5, max_dq=.06)
+p["move_ee"]("left", [.565, .059, .78], q, linear=5, max_dq=.05, settle=20)

+p["move_ee"]("left", [.576, .25, .94], q, linear=5, max_dq=.04, settle=15)
+p["hold"](30)
+
+# Place its full footprint onto the target with a slow tabletop push.
+p["close_gripper"]("left", steps=15)
+p["move_ee"]("left", [.43, .239, .90], q, linear=4, max_dq=.05, settle=10)
+p["move_ee"]("left", [.43, .239, .785], q, linear=4, max_dq=.04, settle=10)

+p["move_ee"]("left", [.53, .239, .94], q, linear=5, max_dq=.04, settle=20)
+
+actions = s.record_stop()
+s.save_trajectory(actions, output, meta={"source": "gen.py", "n_actions": len(actions)})
+print("saved", output, len(actions), s.status(), flush=True)
*** End Patch`;
